verdict.rationale: Gunderson's own early-stage company page names a pre-seed practice built around SAFEs and convertible notes. Its seed and venture financings page states a dedicated financing practice with large volume figures and a PitchBook most-active ranking. However, the SAFE and convertible-instrument depth rests on one sentence, and the volume figures are not broken out for pre-seed or seed convertible rounds. Missing for 10: published SAFE or convertible-note explainers or forms, SAFE-specific deal counts or examples for pre-seed and seed rounds, and independent corroboration of SAFE expertise.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents deep experience with SAFEs and convertible instruments for pre-seed and seed rounds — published explainers, forms, or a stated early-stage financing practice

citations.quote: Often the first item on the agenda is raising an initial round of pre-seed capital by selling simple agreements for future equity (SAFEs) or convertible notes to friends and family, angels and early-stage VCs.
1,600+ venture financings closed for company clients since 2023
For the 12th consecutive year, Gunderson Dettmer has been named the most active VC law firm globally by the 2025 PitchBook Global League Tables.
